comment: Provenance pin for the zero-shot label set. Paths are derived from photo-tools src/photo_tools/data/ram_tag_mapping.yaml (Objects/* and Scenes/*). The yaml itself is not vendored. taxonomy_paths.txt is the deterministic path list; labels.py refuses a mapping that drifts. A git commit is recorded only when that mapping reproduces taxonomy_paths_sha256.

source.note: Declared public repo https://github.com/j23n/photo-tools is currently private or returns 404, so no commit whose mapping reproduces taxonomy_paths_sha256 can be verified from this environment. Path/hash pins remain required. Source-provenance verification is a manual gate (warning, non-blocking in CI) until a matching commit is pinned. Do not invent a source commit.
